I'm having the same problem. Usually the crash happens when closing a window, but sometimes also when interacting with the window in other ways (e.g. clicking the maximize button, or in this case when I just moved my mouse to the top bar). 

This doesn't seem to affect all of my projects equally, but I'm still unsure of what the trigger is.

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7261) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads)
